F1: The old static imports already loaded every integration eagerly, so this is no regression. Any startup failure would also have broken the old code at import time.
F2: Moving `getCalendar` into a discarded async `forEach` callback means its rejections, including CalendarService constructor errors, now escape the surrounding try/catch as unhandled rejections. This happens in all three reschedule paths, so they should use an awaited loop or `Promise.all`.
